response.sql:
WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS overall_avg_price
  FROM InvoiceLine
),
invoice_summary AS (
  SELECT 
    i.InvoiceId,
    c.Country,
    AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS invoice_avg_price,
    AVG(il.UnitPrice) - (SELECT overall_avg_price FROM overall_avg) AS deviation
  FROM Invoice i
  JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
  JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
  GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country
)
SELECT 
  InvoiceId,
  Country,
  invoice_avg_price,
  deviation,
  deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS deviation_above_country_avg
FROM invoice_summary
ORDER BY deviation_above_country_avg DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: "The average across all invoices" refers to the overall average of all invoice line unit prices across the entire InvoiceLine table (not the average of each invoice's average unit price). This weights each line equally and may give more influence to invoices with more lines.

alternatives.interpretation: "The average across all invoices" could mean the average of each invoice's average unit price, treating all invoices equally regardless of line count.
